title: fix(sdp): fence indented SDP example as text to fix doctest
body:
## Summary

- `cargo test --doc -p sip-sdp` fails on `main` after #20 landed because the `parse_a_line` doc comment has an indented block containing `\r\n` — rustdoc treats indented blocks in `///` as implicit Rust code blocks and tries to compile the SDP snippet.
- Wrap the example in a `\`\`\`text` fence so rustdoc skips it.

No functional change — the `parse_a_line` impl is untouched.

## Test plan

- [x] `cargo test --doc -p sip-sdp` now passes (7/7).
- [x] `cargo test -p sip-sdp` (unit + doc) all green.
